question: On which river in India was the Somasila Dam built?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pennar river**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Somasila Dam is built on the **Pennar river** in India.
 
• The dam is located in the Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is primarily used for irrigation and water supply
